One of my mom's friends is constantly making excessive minnats (for example, I will pray 200 salat-ut-tasbeeh, or finish the quran 50 times if such and such a thing happens). After the her duaa is accepted and the event happens she is unable to fulfill her minnat and almost forces my mom to help her fulfill it; for example, you read quran 40 times, I'll read it 10 times. Because the person is asking you to do a good deed you cannot refuse it, but it is also difficult to carry out the minnat within the period of time the friend gives. For this reason I was wondering if it is alright to tell the person to 1. not make such excessive minnats that you can't fulfill yourself 2. to pray or carry out the good deed before you make the duaa (since making minnat is sort of like playing with allah). answer: Prayers & Duties >> Oaths & Vows Question ID: 62413 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Salatul Ishraq Question: Something is troubling me since some days. Once I made an oath to pray Ishraq salah everyday without breaking it and that time I did not know that I cannot break it ever since. Some days ago I came to know that I have to fulfill it and pray regularly. But I am not feeling to pray regularly as I made oath. Since I made my oath when I did not have information about that I should fulfill my oath without any excuses. Should I pray or its Ok not to pray because as I said I did not have the idea when I made the oath I should fulfill it in any condition. Answer ID: 62413 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 236/236/B=03/1437) Your oath took place. Now you will have to offer Ishraq salah everyday as per your oath. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
